notes.text: Salary model: conglobated (paga base unica, nessuna contingenza/EDR separata). Source: lavoro-economia.it c=153 (CNEL G111), tabella Jul 2026.
Hourly divisor 173 (industria standard, confirmed from lavoro-economia.it). Daily divisor: 26.
Seniority: 5 scatti biennali (cadence_months=24, maximum_count=5). Amounts from published table Jul 2026.
Salary periods: 5 tranches — Jan 2025 (+45 at L4), Jan 2026 (+45 at L4), Jul 2026 (+90, published anchor), Jul 2027 (+90), Jan 2028 (+90). Source: quotidianopiu.it + lavoro-economia.it.
Non-Jul-2026 salary values computed parametrically: each level scaled by the L4 ratio at each tranche. Published Jul 2026 values are the direct source; others are derived.
SIMPLIFICATION: Apprenticeship provisions not modeled (primary CCNL text not publicly available). Field left empty.
SIMPLIFICATION: No employer bilateral funds modeled. No public data found for a cinema-specific bilateral fund for impiegati/tecnici in production companies.

limitation.remediation: Confirm whether a sector bilateral fund applies and pass it as a bilateral fund event.

notes.text: SIMPLIFICATION: the employees of film and audiovisual production are insured with the Fondo pensioni lavoratori dello spettacolo (FPLS, ex ENPALS) of INPS, whose contribution regime differs from the ordinary one; the industria rates are used as an approximation pending a dedicated FPLS contribution ruleset. For the workers enrolled after 31 December 1995 the IVS of the FPLS is the ordinary 33% (23.81 + 9.19) up to the annual massimale (INPS, Calcolo dei contributi IVS dei lavoratori dello spettacolo, updated 5 October 2026), as charged here; approximated are the daily bands of the workers enrolled before 1996 (massimale 892 a day in 2026, solidarity 5% above it) and the non-IVS contributions.

limitation.remediation: Add a dedicated FPLS contribution ruleset for film and audiovisual production employees.

notes.text: SICKNESS INPS REGIME: the employees insured with the Fondo pensioni lavoratori dello spettacolo, operai and impiegati alike, have their own INPS sickness indemnity (INPS circ. 132/2021): from the fourth day, 60% up to the 20th day and 80% from the 21st to the 180th (regime 'spettacolo'), with 40 daily contributions from 1 January of the year before (SicknessEpisode.daily_contributions).

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 26 Gratifica natalizia o 13° mensilità (p. 19): "Nel caso di inizio o cessazione del rapporto di lavoro durante il corso dell'anno, il lavoratore ha diritto a tanti dodicesimi della gratifica natalizia per quanti sono i mesi di servizio prestato presso l'azienda. Le frazioni di mese superiori a 15 giorni sono considerate come mese intero di servizio.". Added: more_than 15 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

reviews.scope: The comporto and the sick pay of the CCNL counted over several illnesses (work_rules.sickness_rules), read on the signed text.
findings: Art. 35 of the CCNL 9.7.2019 (pp. 24-26, OCR of the signed scan): comporto 12 months, whole pay for 3, 5 or 8 months and half for 3, 4 or 4 by seniority, the absences of the 24 months before each new episode summed. The file kept 270 days of one illness at 100% with an unpaid carenza: corrected to a cumulation over two years with three seniority bands.

reviews.scope: Values a primary-text verification found different from the printed tables (text layer).
findings: 36 values corrected to the amounts printed on the cited pages.

reviews.scope: Monthly values on scanned pages, each read twice from the page image by two independent sessions of another model, the second without being told the expected value.
findings: 19 values read identically by both readings and equal to the file.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.section: Parte Comune, Art. 35 - Trattamento in caso di malattia o infortunio non sul lavoro
location.quote: al lavoratore non in prova spetta la conservazione del posto per 12 mesi ed il seguente trattamento: [...] 1. non superiore a 5 anni - 3 mesi a retribuzione intera e 3 dimezzata; 2. da 5 a 10 anni - 5 mesi a retribuzione intera e 4 dimezzata; 3. superiore a 10 anni - 8 mesi a retribuzione intera e 4 dimezzata. [...] si intendono riferiti alle assenze complessivamente verificatesi nei 24 mesi precedenti ogni nuovo ultimo episodio morboso.

provenance.transformation: Art. 35: the job is kept 12 months (365 days) at every seniority; the whole net pay for 3, 5 or 8 months and half of it for 3, 4 or 4 more up to 5 years, from 5 to 10 years and above 10 years of seniority, nothing for the later days of the comporto; the sick days of the 24 months before are summed, for the comporto and the pay alike. Months of 365/12 days: 91 and 183, 152 and 274, 243 and 365 days; the bands start at 60 and 120 completed months. The company tops up the INPS indemnity to the net pay (net_basis), from the first day. Stored as a cumulation with a band of each seniority over a two-year window. Read on 2026-10-31.
provenance.note: Not modelled: the days of life-saving therapy (up to 60) left out of the pay limits and paid in full; the 6 months of unpaid aspettativa of a particularly serious illness. The troupe staff of the film productions are outside this CCNL.

location.section: Art. 28 - Festività, riposo settimanale diversi dalla domenica; Art. 29
location.quote: Qualora una delle suddette festività cada di domenica ai lavoratori è dovuto, in aggiunta alla normale retribuzione mensile, l'importo di una quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto, pari a 1/26 della retribuzione mensile fissa ovvero ragguagliata ad 1/6 dell'orario settimanale normale per i lavoratori non retribuiti in misura fissa. [...] Per quanto riguarda la festività nazionale del 4 novembre la cui celebrazione è spostata alla domenica successiva, resta fermo il disposto di cui alla lett. a) del punto 3) dell'accordo interconfederale 26 gennaio 1977.

provenance.transformation: The festività of letters A) and B) of art. 28 (Easter Sunday among them, always a Sunday; but the Patrono) on a Sunday: the monthly pay of the chain over 26 (the workers paid a fixed monthly pay). 4 November: the accordo interconfederale 26 January 1977 the article recalls gives it the treatment of a holiday on a Sunday, as the industry CCNLs quoting it (Federmeccanica art. 9, Chimica art. 13) state.
provenance.note: The 2019 text (valid from 18 January 2018 for three years) is expired and no later renewal was located. The accordo interconfederale of 1977 was not read: its 4 November treatment is inferred from the CCNLs that quote it. The Patrono is not in the national calendar and is not paid. 4 October, a holiday from 2026 (L. 151/2025), is not in the list: its Sunday stays open.
